---
title: "Sources"
format: html
---

The data for this project comes from the World Bank's World Development Indicators (WDI), accessed using the `WDI` R package.

The project uses three indicators:

- GDP in current US dollars: `NY.GDP.MKTP.CD`
- Trade openness as a percentage of GDP: `NE.TRD.GNFS.ZS`
- Fiscal balance as a percentage of GDP: `GC.BAL.CASH.GD.ZS`

Data is retrieved for SAARC member countries:

- Afghanistan
- Bangladesh
- Bhutan
- India
- Maldives
- Nepal
- Pakistan
- Sri Lanka

Coverage spans annual observations from 2000 to 2024.

Cleaning steps include:

- renaming indicators into analysis-friendly variable names
- filtering out observations with missing values in the core variables
- retaining a consistent regional sample for comparison across time
